parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Filter by order status. Accepts a single status, a comma-separated list of statuses
(e.g. `InProcess,Processed,Shipped`) or the `Any` wildcard. Status names are case-insensitive.
            
- `Any` - Include orders with any status.
- `InProcess` - The order is currently being processed.
- `Processed` - The order has been processed.
- `Shipped` - The order has been shipped to the customer.
- `PendingCredit` - The order is pending credit approval.
- `Canceled` - The order has been canceled.
- `Pending` - The order is pending for approval.
- `Paid_NET` - The order has been paid via invoice (NET).
- `Ordered` - Vendor orders were placed for the order.
- `PendingShipment` - The order is ready and pending shipment.
- `Deleted` - The order has been deleted.
Beyond the standard statuses above, some projects define custom statuses.
These are also accepted by this filter — pass the exact status name (case-insensitive).

_Example:_ InProcess,Processed,Shipped

post.description:
Creates an order by upload an order document as a file using "multipart/form-data" content type.
            
Specify the import type in the query parameter "type", currently supported "EHF" and "BIS" options to import UBL order documents (ver 1.0/3.0).
The file must be a valid format according to the specified import type, with the correct file extension (".xml" for EHF)
and the file size must not exceed 1MB.
            
Document prices are applied by default. When the customer account is set to ignore requested prices
in order imports, the current webshop prices are used instead and a price note is recorded.

post.description:
Creates an order by post an order document as a raw text using "text/plain" content type.
            
Specify the import type in the query parameter "type", currently supported "EHF" and "BIS" options to import UBL order documents (ver 1.0/3.0).
The content must be a valid format according to the specified import type and the content size must not exceed 1MB.
            
Document prices are applied by default. When the customer account is set to ignore requested prices
in order imports, the current webshop prices are used instead and a price note is recorded.
            
The endpoint is the same as "/orders/import/file", just another request content type.

status.description:
Filter by order status. Accepts a single status, a comma-separated list of statuses
(e.g. `InProcess,Processed,Shipped`) or the `Any` wildcard. Status names are case-insensitive.
            
- `Any` - Include orders with any status.
- `InProcess` - The order is currently being processed.
- `Processed` - The order has been processed.
- `Shipped` - The order has been shipped to the customer.
- `PendingCredit` - The order is pending credit approval.
- `Canceled` - The order has been canceled.
- `Pending` - The order is pending for approval.
- `Paid_NET` - The order has been paid via invoice (NET).
- `Ordered` - Vendor orders were placed for the order.
- `PendingShipment` - The order is ready and pending shipment.
- `Deleted` - The order has been deleted.
Beyond the standard statuses above, some projects define custom statuses.
These are also accepted by this filter — pass the exact status name (case-insensitive).

Type of delivery for this order.
"DROPSHIP" = order shipped to end user address.
"WAREHOUSE" = order shipped to warehouse.
Null when the delivery type is unknown (order details are missing).

warehouseNumber.description: Warehouse number. Only applicable when deliveryType is "WAREHOUSE".

placedBy.description: User who placed the order in vendor system.

shippingAddress.description: Order shipping address. For dropship orders - the end user's address. For warehouse orders - the warehouse address.

addressLine1.description: Address line for street address and house number or P.O. box. Required.

addressLine2.description: Additional address line for c/o, company (for private recipient with business address), apartment number, etc. Optional.

VendorOrderAddress.description: Address information for a vendor order.

quantity.description: Product quantity in the order line.

vendorCost.description: Vendor product cost without tax in cents.

subtotal.description: Order line subtotal value in cents.

claimNumber.description: Number of special agreements applied to the product.

createdAtMin.description: Filter by creation time from value in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ)

createdAtMax.description: Filter by creation time to value in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ)

createdAtDays.description: Filter by creation period in days

offset.description: Return items from offset zero-based number
Return items from offset zero-based number

basicAuth.description: Enter API credentials provided by administrators.
